title: Why can't a Raft leader commit old entries by counting replicas?

cast.name: Mira
cast.role: Interviewer who asks one bounded question

cast.name: Theo
cast.role: Candidate, fast and a little too sure

glossary.full: A consensus algorithm designed to be understandable
A numbered period with at most one leader

glossary.note: An empty entry a new leader appends to commit older ones.

key_points: Majority replication alone does not make an old-term entry safe (Figure 8).
A leader commits only entries from its own term by counting replicas.
Committing one current-term entry commits everything before it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Whiteboard interview. Five Raft servers, each log entry tagged with the term that wrote it. Alpha leads term 2, and has copied its newest entry to beta.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.text: Proposed rule: once a majority stores an entry, it's committed. Agree?

beats.speaker: theo
beats.text: A majority has it, so it's safe. Always.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.text: Alpha crashes. Epsilon wins term 3 with votes from gamma and delta, and writes its own entry in that slot.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.text: Epsilon crashes. Alpha restarts, wins term 4, and copies its term 2 entry to gamma.

beats.speaker: theo
beats.text: Three servers hold it. Majority. Committed.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.text: Alpha crashes again. Epsilon returns. Its last entry is term 3, newer than term 2, so beta, gamma and delta vote for it.

visuals.text: the newer last term wins the vote

beats.speaker: mira
beats.text: Epsilon leads term 5, overwriting that slot everywhere.

beats.speaker: theo
beats.text: But a majority had it! It looked committed, and vanished.

beats.speaker: theo
beats.text: Redraw one edge: a leader never counts replicas to commit an old-term entry. Only entries from its own term.

visuals.text: Count replicas only for entries from the leader's own term

beats.speaker: mira
beats.text: Once one current-term entry sits on a majority, everything before it is committed too. Logs agreeing on one entry agree on all earlier ones.

beats.speaker: theo
beats.text: So replicate something from its own term first.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.text: Many implementations append a no-op on election for that.
